chat.said: We need to decide whether to hire a Tech lead or two developers to boost productivity and meet our next feature-launch deadline on January 12th

answer.text: The hiring comparison turns on what is blocking delivery and whether hires can contribute before launch. The model does not yet establish which route fits your team: its workload, contribution and hiring delays are exploratory what-ifs, not team forecasts.

why.text: More implementation capacity may not help if technical decisions, review or external dependencies constrain delivery.
The model measures delivery volume, not efficiency, and leaves launch gates and additional onboarding disruption unresolved.

text.text: Ask the team to trace blocked launch work: would implementation help unblock it, or would technical direction? External blockers would challenge both hiring premises.
